text:
alex: Created RC candidate rc-20260320-1 from main @ commit abcdef1. Artifacts uploaded and pinned to s3://redwood/artifacts/rc-20260320-1.tar.gz. Planning promotion in tonight's 21:00 UTC change window. No DB migrations in this RC. Release notes: https://go/redwood/releases/rc-20260320-1

maria: Quick checklist - perf smoke, canary traffic plan, oncall handoff. I can own the smoke once QA gives thumbs.

jordan: I ran unit/integration on the candidate branch, all green. Small lint warn but non-blocking.

qa-bot: QA run complete (smoke + regression subset). Failures: 0, Flaky tests: 1 (test_search_timeout) - flake ticket #JIRA-453.

alex: tagging for promote: rc=rc-20260320-1, pin=artifact:rc-20260320-1, rollout_policy=staged-canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%, 15m between stages).

deploy-bot: queued promotion request for rc-20260320-1 into PROD window 2026-03-20T21:00:00Z. To approve: add "deploy-bot approve" reaction or post "/deploy approve rc-20260320-1" in this thread.

sara-oncall: Oncall acked. I'll be standby for the promo and the 30m rollback window. Please ensure the rollback playbook link is attached.

kevin: Rollback plan confirmed: fallback image tag rc-20260319-stable, traffic cutover back to incumbent, healthcheck gating on 5xx > 0.5% or latency P95 > 300ms. Manual rollback steps in ops-runbook -> section 'rc rollback'.

maria: One addendum: disable KV cache pre-warm for first canary to avoid cache-induced spikes. I'll update the deploy config.

alex: Updated deploy config snippet:
```
rollout: staged-canary
stages:
  - pct: 5
    duration: 15m
    prehooks: [smoke-tests]
    env_overrides: {KV_PREWARM: "false"}
  - pct: 25
    duration: 15m
  - pct: 100
    duration: 0m
```

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled. Canary job created: job/rc-20260320-1-canary-20260320-2100 (owner: eng-release). Logs will stream to https://go/redwood/logs/rc-20260320-1-canary.

jordan: I've prepared a short prompt/behavior smoke set to evaluate quality regressions. Will post results after first canary finishes.

qa-bot: Post-canary regressions checklist: prompt_set=smoke_prompts_v4, metric_thresholds={exact_match: 0.95, safety_flags: 0}. Will auto-fail on safety flags.

alex: final thumbs? We need at least: QA, Oncall, Eng-release owner.

maria: QA thumbs. :white_check_mark:

jordan: Eng-release owner thumbs. :thumbsup:

sara-oncall: Oncall ready. :handshake:

alex: All checks satisfied, proceeding to trigger deploy at 21:00 UTC. Reminder: no DB migrations and no infra changes. If anything odd, call the rollback channel @ops-rollback and ping me.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rc-20260320-1 -> PROD (staged-canary). Tracking id: deploy-rc-1766432100.

deploy-bot: canary stage reached 5% - monitoring healthhooks and custom probes.

jordan: first-canary smoke results: all prompts within thresholds, no safety flags. Posting small sample: 
```
prompt: "Summarize last commit" -> "Added runtime flags for kv prewarm control"
```

maria: Moving to 25% in 5m.

deploy-bot: stage advanced to 25%.

deploy-bot: health alert triggered: 5xx spikes observed on region eu-west-1 (0.8% for 2m). Auto-hold engaged. Recommend rollback if spike persists >5m.

sara-oncall: Investigating. Rolling back 25% stage to 5% now to limit blast radius.

kevin: Initiating manual traffic rollback to rc-20260319-stable for eu-west-1 only. Not global yet.

deploy-bot: rollback partial executed for eu-west-1. Canary job marked: degraded -> rollback-partial.

alex: Noted. Cancel global promotion. Let's keep RC pinned for later investigation; do not unpin. Create postmortem if root cause >15m.

maria: I'll pull logs and look into KV cache interactions and routing changes in eu-west-1.

jordan: I'll run a quick diff of the runtime kernel selection logs between rc and stable.

qa-bot: Re-run smoke on remaining 5% canary in other regions - no failures reported.

sara-oncall: Oncall remains on duty for the next hour. If we see new regressions, escalate to infra.

alex: Thanks everyone. Leaving the RC pinned and creating a follow-up thread for RCA. We'll reschedule a re-promotion after root cause and a hotfix if needed.
